boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-admission activities on campus and around Tacoma, with current free-access evidence.

cards.title: See an exhibition at Kittredge Gallery
cards.subtitle: Kittredge Hall, University of Puget Sound
cards.notes: Meet up during an exhibition, take a slow lap through the galleries, then use the artist-talk format to compare what you noticed.
cards.short_summary: Campus gallery exhibitions and artist talks are free and open to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that Kittredge Gallery exhibitions and artist talks are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions run September through May; check the gallery calendar before going.

cards.entity_name: Puget Sound Museum of Natural History
cards.title: Book a specimen-viewing visit
cards.subtitle: University of Puget Sound campus
cards.notes: Arrange an appointment with friends to view natural-history specimens and spend time with the museum’s rotating student-curated displays.
cards.short_summary: A campus natural-history collection with free public admission by appointment.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Puget Sound Museum of Natural History is free to the public, and the museum is open by appointment.
cards.source_title: University of Puget Sound Announces New Director for Natural History Museum
cards.access_notes: Contact the museum to arrange an appointment before visiting.

cards.title: Catch a Noon Convocation recital
cards.subtitle: Schneebeck Concert Hall, University of Puget Sound
cards.notes: Bring a friend to a select Wednesday recital, listen to short student performances, and leave time afterward to talk through the program.
cards.short_summary: Short student recital performances presented at noon on select Wednesdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound’s School of Music describes Noon Convocations as select Wednesday student recital performances that are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: School of Music for Students and the Community
cards.access_notes: Held on select Wednesdays from noon to 1 p.m.; consult the events calendar for dates.

cards.entity_name: Puget Sound Bike and Ski Shop
cards.title: Get a bike tune-up together
cards.subtitle: University of Puget Sound campus
cards.notes: Bring a bike with a friend, ask the student-run shop about a repair, and use the visit as a low-key hands-on campus stop.
cards.short_summary: The student-run shop provides free bicycle repairs for Puget Sound students.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the Puget Sound Bike and Ski Shop provides free bicycle repairs for Puget Sound students.
cards.access_notes: Free bicycle repairs are for Puget Sound students; ask the shop about repair availability.

cards.title: Use the Puget Sound museum benefit
cards.subtitle: 1701 Pacific Ave, Tacoma
cards.notes: Bring a current Puget Sound ID, choose a gallery to explore together, and check the museum’s event listings before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: Puget Sound ID holders receive unlimited complimentary general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound’s MUSE membership provides unlimited complimentary Tacoma Art Museum admission for current students, faculty, and staff with university ID.
cards.access_notes: Present a current Puget Sound student, faculty, or staff ID; group tours for 10 or more require preregistration.

cards.title: Wander the conservatory displays
cards.subtitle: Wright Park, 316 S G St, Tacoma
cards.notes: Take a relaxed pass through the historic glasshouse, pause at the seasonal displays, and skip the optional donation if it is not in your plan.
cards.short_summary: A historic Wright Park conservatory with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Parks Tacoma lists admission to W.W. Seymour Botanical Conservatory as free, with a suggested $3 donation.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; the donation is optional.

cards.title: Join the Point Defiance Bird Walk
cards.subtitle: Point Defiance Park, Tacoma
cards.notes: Meet the Park Guide for the scheduled walk, bring binoculars if you have them, and use the group pace to learn local birds together.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Park Guide-led bird walk at Point Defiance Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Parks Tacoma lists the Point Defiance Bird Walk as a free recurring activity, including an August 23, 2026 walk.
cards.access_notes: The listed August 23, 2026 walk runs 9–11 a.m.; verify the series page for future dates.

cards.title: Walk Titlow with a Park Guide
cards.subtitle: Titlow Park & Lodge, 8425 6th Ave, Tacoma
cards.notes: Join the all-ages guided walk through the shore and forest, then stay in the park to compare sightings with your group.
cards.short_summary: An all-ages guided bird walk through Titlow Park’s shore and forest.
cards.evidence_claim: Parks Tacoma lists the Titlow Bird Walk as a free all-ages activity on August 16, 2026.
cards.access_notes: Listed for August 16, 2026, 9–11 a.m.; check the event calendar for updates.

cards.title: Watch a free outdoor movie at STAR Center
cards.subtitle: STAR Center, 3873 S 66th St, Tacoma
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or lawn chair, pack your own snacks, and settle in with friends for games and the outdoor Zootopia 2 screening.
cards.short_summary: A free family-friendly outdoor movie night with games and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Parks Tacoma describes the August 21, 2026 Summer Bash at STAR Center as free and includes a Zootopia 2 outdoor screening.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled Friday, August 21, 2026 at 6:30 p.m.; the PG movie begins at dusk and lawn seating is used.

cards.title: Use a free guest computer session
cards.subtitle: Main Library, 1102 Tacoma Ave S, Tacoma
cards.notes: Meet at the Main Library for a research or planning session; ask staff for a guest computer pass if you do not have a library card.
cards.short_summary: Tacoma Public Library provides free computer access and guest passes.
cards.evidence_claim: Tacoma Public Library states that it provides free computer access and free guest passes for computers for people without a library card.
cards.source_title: Tax help at Tacoma Public Library
cards.access_notes: Computer availability is subject to library open hours; request a free guest pass from staff if needed.
